description: Deliver a release (single, album, EP, podcast episodes, spoken word, audiobook chapters) to PENNY. Tracks are pulled server-side from public Google Drive or Dropbox share links (https) — nothing uploads from the agent. contentOrigin is REQUIRED and permanent (Pillar 2 transparency): AI_GEN, HYBRID, or ORGANIC. Tracks without an ISRC receive a sequential PENNY house ISRC automatically at finalize. Free until the window closes; no exclusivity; the creator keeps all rights. Returns releaseId and live status.

genre.description: e.g. Metal, Podcast, Spoken Word, Audiobook

releaseRef.description: Your stable release id (optional — defaults to a slug of artist + title)

isrc.description: Optional — a PENNY house ISRC is assigned when omitted

sourceUrl.description: Public Google Drive or Dropbox share link (https)

trackRef.description: Your stable track id (optional — defaults to t1, t2, …)

name: penny_deliver_release
